run_convert_dataset_to_hdf5: run the script to convert an ImageNet dataset to HDF5 format for improved I/O
run_extract_features_to_hdf5: run the script to extract ResNet50 features from images and save them to HDF5
run_convert_coco_dataset: run the script to convert a COCO dataset with instance segmentations to HDF5 format
run_save_images_only: run the script with --save_images_only to store only images and labels in HDF5
run_save_features_only: run the script with --save_features_only to store only extracted features in HDF5
